description: This file defines the 'ImportModal' component responsible for handling file imports in the web application. It includes logic for managing import state, parsing files, importing payloads, and UI interactions such as opening and closing the modal, as well as handling import progress and success/error states.

classes.name: ImportModal
classes.description: React functional component managing the import modal interface, including file upload, import process, and UI state management.

methods.name: reducer
methods.description: State reducer function handling actions to update the import modal's state.

methods.name: importFromPayloads
methods.description: Imports data from transfer payloads, updating file status and displaying success or error messages.

methods.name: parseAndImport
methods.description: Main function to parse files, retrieve payloads, and perform the import operation, including creating an import tag.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Closes the import modal and optionally updates the selected tag.
